content: Gita Bonchon Yerusalaame Geluwa
Enti Yerusalaame matishe, Shamaho zuma matan de7iya Beetefaagenne Bitaane katamata gakidosona. Yesuusi ba tamaaretape nam7ata sinthe kiittidi,
“Hintefe sinthan de7iya gutaa biite; yaa gelida mela oonika toggiboonna qashon de7iya hare mari hinte demmana, iya billidi, haa eki yiite.
Oonika hintena, ‘Haysa ayis oothetii?’ yaagidi oychiko, ‘Goday iya koyees, ellesidi haa yeddana’ yaagite” yaagis.
Enti bidi, hare mari kare bolla oge matan qashetidi de7eysa demmidi billidosona.
He bessan eqida issi issi asati entako, “Hare maraa waatanaw billeetii?” yaagidi oychidosona.
Iya tamaareti Yesuusi bantana kiittidaysa odin, asati yeddi aggidosona.
Enti hare maraa Yesuusako ehidi, banta ma7uwa iya zokon hiixin Yesuusi he hare maraa toggis.
Daro asay banta ma7uwa ogiyan hiixidosona; qassi harati mitha tashe tashidi, ogen hiixidosona.
Yesuusape sinthara hemetiya asaynne iya kaalliya asay banta qaala dhoqu oothidi,
yaagidosona.
Yesuusi Yerusalaame bidi, Xoossaa Keetha gelis. Qassi ubbaba yuuyi xeellidaape guye, sa7i qammiya gisho, tammanne nam7u tamaaretara Bitaane katama bis.
Yesuusi Baaddida Balase Mithiw
Wontetha gallas enti Bitaanepe keyidi bishin, Yesuusi koshatis.

Haahon issi balase mithiw haytha xalaala ma7a uttidaaro be7idi, I bolla ayfey bentiko gidi, be7anaw iiko bis, shin iiko I biya wode, haytha xalaalape attishin, issi ayfeka demmibeenna; ayis giiko, balasey ayfiya wodey gakibeenna.
Yesuusi he balasiw, “Hiza, asi neepe merinaw ayfe moopo” yaagis. Iya tamaareti I geysa si7idosona.
Xoossa Keethan Zal7eyisata Kessis
Enti Yerusalaame bidosona; Yesuusi Xoossa Keethi gelidi, yan bayzeysatanne shammeyisata kare goodo oykis; qassi miishe laammeyisata xarpheezanne holle bayzeyisata oydiya shiri yeggidi,
asi aybibaaka tookidi, xoossa keetha giddora aadhona mela diggis.
Yesuusi asaa haysada yaagidi tamaarsis: “Geeshsha Maxaafan, ‘Ta keethay asi ubbay Xoossaa woossiya keethi gidana’ geetetidi xaafetis. Shin hinte iya pangati qosetiya gongolo oothideta” yaagis.
Kahine halaqatinne higge astamaareti hessa si7idi, iya wodhanaw oge koydosona. Shin daro asay iya timirtiyan malaaletiya gisho, iyaw babidosona.
Sa7ay omarsiya wode Yesuusinne iya tamaareti katamaape gaxa keyidosona.
Balase Mithiya Melasu
Enti wontetha gallas he ogiyara aadhishe, he balasiya xaphora melidaaro be7idosona.
Phexroosi akeekidi, “Astamaariyaw, Heko, neeni baaddida balasiya melasu” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Xoossaa ammanite.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; oonika ba wozanan sidhonna gidabay hananaysa ammanidi, ha zumaa, ‘Dendada abban kunda’ yaagiko iyaw hanana.
Hessa gisho, taani hintew odayis; Xoossaa hinte woossiyabanne oychiyaba ayba gidikoka ekidaada ammanite, hinte ekana.
Xoossaa woossanaw hinte eqiya wode, salon de7iya hinte Aaway hinte nagara atto gaana mela, oonika hintena naaqidabay de7iko, iyaw atto giite.
Shin asa nagara hinte atto goonna ixiko, salon de7iya hinte Aawayka hinte nagaraa hintew atto geenna” yaagis.
Yesuusa Maatay Oyshetis
Enti zaaridi Yerusalaame bidosona. Yesuusi xoossa keethan hemetishin, kahine halaqati, higge astamaaretinne cimati iyako yidi,
“Neeni haysa oothanaw new ay maati de7ii? Woyko new ha maata immiday oonee?” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ta hintena issiba oychana, taw odite. Ta qassi haysa ay maatan oothiyako, hintew odana.
Yohaanisa xinqatey Xoossafeye woyko asapee? Taw odite” yaagis.
Enti banta giddon palama doomidi, “Nuuni, ‘Xoossafe’ giiko, I nuuko, ‘Yaatin, Yohaanisi odidaysa ayis ammanibeketii?’ yaagana.
‘Asape giiko’ asa ubbay Yohaanisi nabe gideysa eroosona.” Hessa gisho, asaas yayidosona.
Hessa gisho, enti Yesuusako, “Nuuni eroko” yaagidi zaaridosona. Yesuusi, “Taanika haysa ay maatan oothiyako, hintew odike” yaagis.
